name: What is involved in material selection support for a custom renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in material selection support for a custom renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Material selection support is an integrated part of our design-build process at AKN Design Group, ensuring your vision translates into tangible results. We guide you through choosing finishes and fixtures that align with your aesthetic preferences, functional needs, and the overall design concept. This managed process typically involves presenting curated options for cabinetry, countertops, flooring, tile, lighting, and plumbing fixtures. We consider durability, maintenance, and how different materials complement each other to enhance functionality, beauty, and long-term value, ultimately creating a cohesive and customized space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Material selection support involves guided choices for finishes and fixtures like cabinetry, countertops, and flooring, ensuring they align with your project's design and functional needs.
